Dan is currently CFO at Alterian Software, a leading customer journey orchestration software and analytics platform, majority owned by PE fund Allomer Capital. Prior to Alterian, Dan held CFO and senior corporate and business development positions at several leading venture backed companies in the enterprise software and healthcare sectors, including:  - CFO for Retrace Labs, Inc., a leading provider of AI-enabled software facilitating real-time connectivity between healthcare payors, providers and patients. (UK), a leading provider of AI/ML and robotics-enabled automated lab and analytical services to clients in the pharma and biotech space.  - Senior advisor to Senseer Health, Inc., a developer of Smart Medical Device Therapies to manage various chronic conditions in neurologic and cardiovascular indication markets.  Prior to these roles, for nearly 11 years, Dan led origination and execution of cross-border US - Asia M&A and capital raising mandates for CEC Capital, the US affiliate of CEC Capital Group, an Asia-based investment bank focused on the Internet software and services space; telecom, media, and entertainment industries; as well as healthcare and life sciences sectors. He was also the head of the US office and oversaw administrative responsibilities in the US for the firm. From 2012 to 2016, Dan was a managing director at Siemer & Associates, a Los Angeles-based tech, consumer and media-focused investment bank, prior to its acquisition by CEC Capital.  During the early 2000s, Dan was also a member of the investment team at TPG Capital (TPG Asia), where he was involved on cross-border buyout and venture investments in the U.S. and Asia. pool_records.headline: Darren Misaresh is an LA native with a passion for business. His most recent business endeavor has been the successful concept development, construction and operation of Mansion Fitness in West Hollywood, California. His previous accomplishments include being heavily involved in the opening of Kitchen 24 in Hollywood California overseeing operations. Prior to that he was a Project Manager for Hello Inside Design, which involved complete renovations of homes and commercial spaces from concept to completion. Darren has always been a goal oriented, self-driven and charismatic individual. He feels that being well rounded is a combination of life experience and education, he believes that in order to be successful in business you must embody both. He has many years of professional experience and his educational background is impressive. He received his Bachelors Degree from Loyola Marymount University in 2009 graduating Magna Cum Laude. During his time at LMU he founded the LMU Finance Society and was inducted into the International Business Honor Society, Beta Gamma Sigma for his outstanding work both educationally and professionally as being in the top 10% of business students worldwide. He returned to LMU in 2011 to pursue a Masters in Business Administration and graduated in 2012. His future plans for his current business, Mansion Fitness is to expand to the westside within the next year. He truly loves the challenge of being an entrepreneur. The freedom to express his talents and to see his vision become a reality makes it all worth the effort. He lives by the words of Confucius, “choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life.”

pool_records.headline: Zinda Colburn is an lifelong entrepreneur, hemp broker, philanthropist, and agricultural supply chain and product-development consultant. Since her beginnings working the fields of her grandfather’s 50-acre heirloom apple orchard in the California Sierras, Zinda has defined the edges of the specialty lawn-and-garden and hydroponic industry with the products she has taken to market.  Keenly observing an unmet need or emerging industry within the ag sector is Zinda’s specialty. Almost all products she has consulted on or developed have become segment leaders. She is recognized for having increased several companies revenues in the triple-digits.  Zinda’s early influence in the specialty lawn-and-garden industry occurred when she was owner of Happy Frog Nursery. Fostering and then divesting this company informs her unique industry vantage. She currently operates several hemp-farmer and investor-facing associations and firms.  Zinda translates her intrinsic beliefs in sustainable products to every venture she steers. In 2016 she set her sights on the nascent Oregon Hemp industry, where she is aligning multiple stakeholders to drive sales in all her positions.  ZInda is a pro-networker that unites different segments.  2023 update !  Zinda is excited to work with the talented team at Grow More fertilizer company. This family owned 105 year old company continues to exemplify excellence with its scientific approach to helping farmers grow food, fuel and fiber. Over the last seven decades Grow More has evolved to its present status as a company, which solves problems through applied research. The strength created by the company results from the application of scientific methology. Constant achievement through applied research describes in brief the total commitment provided by Grow More products and personnel. This happens through quantitative analysis, and quality control. The high degree of professionalism, which exists at Grow More is prominent among the many reasons why customers continue to rely on the firm.
